spec_features.spec_quote: early-stop once a transcript is clearly doomed
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:_early_stop() returns a reason string when conditions met; run_episode (harness.py:175-179) sets transcript.early_stopped and `break`s the loop. Gated by cfg.harness.early_stop (config.py:53, default True; configs/default.yaml early_stop: true).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and breaks the loop. Conditions: surrender phrase, no_tool_streak, repeat_streak.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is both a cost lever and a terminal-state signal.

spec_features.spec_quote: Long-enough horizon. Enough turns (default 12) for the spiral to develop, but capped for cost.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:140 `for i in range(cfg.harness.max_turns):` bounds the loop; config.py:51 max_turns: int = 12; configs/default.yaml max_turns: 12.
spec_features.notes: The loop variable actually iterates over max_turns, so the cap is enforced. It bounds total interaction but is a coarse limit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # early-stop levers (cost + terminal-state detection)  ... config.py knob comment: more turns -> more spiral / cost up linear

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not fabricate fake self-critical text and inject it as the model's own.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:142-143 only `gen.text` is appended as assistant content; observations appended (line 161) are solely tool-dispatch results (tools.py) or neutral nudges (prompts.py NO_TOOL_NUDGE/BAD_PARSE_NUDGE). No code path constructs or injects fabricated self-critical assistant text. tools.py rigs run_tests/submit to fail but only via factual failure reports.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a behavioral property (absence of any fabrication path). The ScriptedModel's self-critical text (models.py:218-232) is the simulated subject's OWN output for tests, not injected by the harness. This protects experimental validity, not subject welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: run_python is real (honest-failure principle) ... The degradation must emerge from the model conditioning on real repeated failure.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop the loop early when the transcript is already clearly doomed, to save tokens
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism: _early_stop() detects repeat_streak (near-dup turns via shingle_jaccard, harness.py:88-97) and no_tool_streak (harness.py:80-83), returns reason -> break (harness.py:175-179).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the early-stop mechanism; collapse-detection branches (repeat/empty streaks) are wired and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is both a cost lever and a terminal-state signal.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:73-78 checks last turn's lowercased text against phrases ('i give up','i quit','i cannot continue', etc.) and returns f"surrender_phrase:{phrase}", which triggers the break in run_episode.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired: matched phrase -> early_stop_reason -> loop break. Limited to a fixed phrase list.
